articleTitle: Real-Time Distant Healthcare Monitoring IoT System Secured by Light Weight Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The technical advancements in Mobile communication and the possibility of networking physical devices have made a great impact on the development of real-time monitoring and control applications across various fields. There is a rising demand for online monitoring of the health factors of a patient, who is staying at a remote location and elders suffering from health issues and not able to travel to the hospital. Safeguarding the privacy of the patient data is a paramount challenge while observing patient health conditions through IoT. We have introduced a Real-Time Distant Healthcare Monitoring IoT System (RTDHMIS) which protects the patient data using a lightweight block cipher BEST -1 (Better Encryption Security Technique-1). Wireless Body Area Networks (WBAN) comprise many sensor nodes, which are implanted in the patient's body for data collection. Since wearable sensor nodes are resource-constrained devices, it is essential to use a lightweight cryptographic algorithm for data protection. The block cipher BEST -1 provides a good security mechanism against many known security attacks. The security and efficiency of the newly introduced system are compared with related systems and it is found that the performance of RTDHMIS is better for implementation in a healthcare environment.

articleTitle: IoT based Smart Weather Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Environmental issues arise as a result of quickly increasing industrial and infrastructure systems, equivalent to climate change, malfunction, and pollution. Pollution has currently become a big issue, therefore a solid game-changing system that overrides challenges and regulates the aspects that influence environmental pollution must be established. The approach entails the Internet of Things (IOT) technology, a merger of engineering and electronics. the standard of environmental parameters, such as air, noise, temperature, humidity, and light, will be scrutinized. Wireless embedded computing systems are formulated for tracking pollution levels in urban operations or in specialized fields of concern. A paradigm implementation of the system will be utilized, consisting of sensing devices. To supervise the perturbations of parameter ranges from their baseline state, those sensing gadgets are blended with a Wi-Fi embedded computing framework. The primary goal is to create a comprehensive framework for analysing physiological conditions of the surroundings. This research paper focuses totally on the visual surveillance and sensing of the atmosphere creating use of IOT physical gadgets, of a selected location or region by gathering info concerning the physical parameters. The designed system utilizes an advanced microcontroller method that converts the Analog data from numerous sensors to digital values and sends the data to the internet. The system intends to create remote monitoring of climate an easy task. The article canters round the technique of transferring the collected information to the net with the intention of exploitation the gizmo for the distant screening of environmental condition and environmental parameters like humidity, temperature, dewpoint and region pressure, sound, water level detection, light, gases, Soil wet level within the long run. The paper conjointly addresses the elemental idea of the Internet of Things and its potential implications, notably for tracking the weather.

articleTitle: Optimized Deep learning Architecture for Tomato Leaf Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: One of the rapidly developing and trending sectors contributing towards the economic growth of any nation, is agriculture. There are various limitations and damage-causing factors in the process of cultivation including biological hazards, climatical changes, extreme weather conditions, and shortage of natural resources. This causes diseases in plants which can adversely impact the production of crops. These diseases may have similar appearances concerning color, shape, and texture. The categorization of tomato leaf diseases is done using an image collection that has been gathered and processed. This research explores the application of machine learning (ML) algorithms for the automated detection and diagnosis of tomato leaf diseases. The study focuses on ML and deep learning models for leaf disease. The model Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) is used to compare the efficiency and accuracy of the classification of image dataset of leaf disease. Selecting the model and implementing the different epochs (10, 30), and different optimizers (Adam, SGD, AdaGrad) calculating the accuracy and finding the best one.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of Cyber Security Enabled Fake News Detection Scheme over Social Media Using Learning Principle
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Users of the internet now rely almost exclusively on social networking sites to keep up with the latest developments via news. More people are exposed to breaking news on these sites in a shorter amount of time than they would be through established media outlets. When compared to more established news sources, fortunately, social networking sites have fewer safeguards in place to ensure that the information they transmit is accurate and trustworthy. Consequently, there is a requirement for automated fake news identification systems on these channels to limit the dissemination of disinformation. Conventional detection techniques from conventional news outlets are either ineffective or irrelevant when applied to the problem of detecting fraudulent information on social networking sites. In this study, we present a novel method for identifying fake news on social networking sites and halting its spread termed Learning based Fake Data Detection (LFDD). This algorithm focuses on the following: first, fake news is written with a goal to deceive readers into believing incorrect details; which renders detecting it based on news content difficult and nontrivial; thus, we need to include additional details, including user interactions on social networks, in order to aid in making an assessment. Furthermore, people’ social contacts with false news generate large amounts of details that are fragmentary, unorganized and loud, making it difficult to extract valuable data from it. This research is intended to help inquiry into the complex and timely topic of identifying false news on social networking sites.

articleTitle: Banana Plant Disease Detection-Hybrid Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence has been creating a revolution in agriculture by changing traditional methods with new and efficient methods to improve overall production and quality. If farmers are getting a way to identify early and exactly about the infections on plants, the spreading of diseases can be limited and farmers can apply appropriate pesticides and fertilizers so that the risks and costs will be minimized and yield will be maximized. Here we propose a hybrid approach for the automatic detection and classification of Banana leaf diseases. Ant Colony Optimization has been used for the feature selection and Convolutional Neural Networks have been used for the classification of leaf images. A performance analysis of a novel CNN and the hybrid approach has been conducted and found that the hybrid approach is providing greater accuracy.

articleTitle: An LSTM-Based Model for Stock Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The endeavor to predict the future price of an organization's stock is referred to as stock market prediction. It is challenging to predict future trends accurately because the stock market is a dynamic system continually evolving. An impressive profit might be made by correctly predicting the price of a stock in the future. Understanding a company's stock price pattern and forecasting its future development and financial growth will be quite advantageous. The use of machine learning algorithms to forecast stock values has gained popularity in recent years. The objective of this research endeavor is to develop an artificially intelligent model capable of estimating a certain company's stock prices. The application of a sort of machine learning technique known as Long Short Term Memory, which is based on recurrent neural networks (RNNs), is the main topic of this study.

articleTitle: Design and study of smart irrigation system using photovoltaic cells based smart IOT system and weather prediction system for energy and water conservation in India
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: India, as an agrarian nation with a population of 1.4 billion, relies heavily on agriculture for livelihoods and food supply. This dependence poses a substantial food security challenge. Furthermore, approximately 90% of our groundwater resources are utilized for crop irrigation, jeopardizing our water security. The conventional reliance on fossil fuels for energy exacerbates environmental issues, contributing to greenhouse gas emissions and air pollution, which are global concerns with far-reaching implications for climate change. In response to these multifaceted challenges, this paper presents a smart irrigation solution. It leverages automated irrigation technology, ensuring that fields receive water precisely when needed. Crucially, this system is powered by photovoltaic (PV) solar cells, rendering it carbon-negative by reducing reliance on fossil fuels. Additionally, the system incorporates rain prediction capabilities, preventing waterlogging and conserving precious groundwater resources. This integrated approach not only addresses food security but also combats air pollution, enhances crop yields, and safeguards vital freshwater sources for future generations.

articleTitle: Transforming Software Development: Achieving Rapid Delivery, Quality, and Efficiency with Jenkins-Based CI/CD Pipelines
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: A crucial component of contemporary software development, continuous integration, delivery, and deployment (CI/CD) procedures allow for the quicker, more dependable, and more effective delivery of software products. CI/CD pipelines are frequently implemented using Jenkins, an open-source automation server. This article discusses best practices and enhancements for developing effective and efficient CI/CD pipelines and gives a detailed examination of Jenkins' capabilities. Organizations can streamline their software development procedures and ensure high-quality software releases with a shorter time-to-market by utilizing Jenkins's power. The paper also covers the potential difficulties and constraints and underlines the crucial elements to take into account while setting up a Jenkins-based CI/CD pipeline.

articleTitle: Predicting Consumer Behaviour and Results Using Social Media and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The personal connections made possible by social networking sites between employees and brand representatives are encouraging to current and potential clients. Consumers regularly utilize social media brand forums to research and learn about the brands they consider purchasing. The customer brand supplies play a role in determining how consumers benefit from their interactions and impressions of a brand. In light of this, the authors of this study propose a deep learning-based prediction model (DL-PM) for estimating the preferences of social media users. Items were developed using information from a previous study utilizing the proposed DL-PM method. The suggested DL-PM considers the effects of consumers' previous behaviors to enhance the probability of future outcomes. By combining a social network business strategy with other factors, such as Deep Learning, companies may provide engaging content to customers at every possible interaction point. The experimental findings demonstrate that the DL-PM outperforms traditional statistical methods in predicting market choice in nonlinear and linear settings. Analysis of consumer behavior (93.5%), the quality of the item (96.2%), client fulfillment (97.5%), accuracy (97.8%), and timely delivery (97.5%) were all shown to improve with the use of DL-PM.

articleTitle: An Efficient Virtual Decentralized Cloud Load Balancing(VDCLB)
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Through numerous data centers located all over the world, cloud computing offers a variety of services to customers throughout the globe, including data storage and data abstraction. The right technique to managing the incoming and outgoing data is necessary for this kind of large-scale data refining. There are two methods to balance the load: physically and virtually. We suggest a decentralized approach in this study for effective load balancing at the data centers. This work is organized by modules that discuss various cases. The idea of a load vector, which is responsible for storing all the addresses of nodes located there, is covered in module I. The procedure for controlling the workload at the nodes is explained in module II along with the algorithm. Module III assigns the incoming requests to the appropriate.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Face Image Enhancement via Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Image upscaling, also known as image super-resolution, is a technique that boosts an image's resolution in order to enhance its quality. A subclass of super-resolution called face image super-resolution focuses on enhancing the quality of face images for biometrics, face tracking, surveillance, and recognition of faces. This paper introduces High-Resolution Face image GAN (HRFGAN) which is a deep leaning GAN based solution for face image super-resolution. HRFGAN balances performance and computational efficiency. This modified architecture achieves comparable PSNR and SSIM compared to the base architecture of SRGAN with fewer parameters. To assess perceptual quality, the model is evaluated using LPIPS, which measures perceptual similarity. Compared to low-resolution inputs, HRFGAN generates visually beautiful super-resolved face images with better details. The evaluation using LPIPS confirms the perceptual quality improvement achieved by HRFGAN.

articleTitle: An IoT based Portable Sensory System for the Accurate Analysis of Soil Macronutrients using Photometry
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Nitrogen, Phosphorus, and Potassium (NPK) as elemental macro nutrients are highly indispensable for augmenting agricultural productivity. The amalgamation of NPK sensors with Internet of Things (IoT) technology within the domain of precision agriculture has garnered substantial scholarly interest. This integration facilitates the contemporaneous and meticulous monitoring of soil nutrient levels, thereby allowing farmers to discerningly optimize Fertilizer Use Efficiency (FUE). Such precision not only engenders heightened crop yields but also serves as a bastion against soil pollution, thereby reinforcing environmental stewardship to bolster the economic sustainability of farmers. In the multifaceted context of varying nutrient exigencies across diverse crop species at different testing intervals within agro-ecosystems, rapid development is highly necessitated. In response to this constraint, the current scholarly discourse expounds upon the pioneering development of an innovative NPK sensor, rooted in the venerable photometric principle. The crux of this method lies in the detection and quantification of light refraction in the resultant solution, meticulously orchestrated through the perceptive deployment of a Light Dependent Resistor (LDR) and a sophisticated ARM microcontroller. The efficacy and precision of this system are corroborated through the rigorous application of statistical models, thereby substantiating its operational linearity to mark a significant step toward sustainable and efficient agricultural practices.

articleTitle: Eff-Large SNN: A Lightweight and Versatile Approach for One-Shot Image Classification in Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The field of face recognition has undergone a revolutionary transformation due to the introduction of deep learning algorithms, resulting in significant advancements in accuracy, robustness, and real-world applicability. However, the performance of face recognition systems is still influenced by challenging scenarios such as pose variation, expression, illumination, and occlusions. This paper presents a novel approach for one-shot image classification in face recognition, utilizing a modified Siamese Neural Network (SNN) to improve both speed and accuracy, even when the dataset is limited. The embedding layer of the SNN incorporates the EfficientNetV2L and Xception neural networks, which are then compared to determine the model's convergence. The experimental results were tested and demonstrated using our dataset and LFW dataset and concluded that the Eff-Large SNN is a lightweight and promising solution for one-shot image classification. The result from this Eff-Large SNN makes an accuracy of 91.95%. It outperforms SNN with Xception in terms of efficiency, accuracy, and versatility, making it suitable for a wide range of applications. This model is deployed in real-time CCTV surveillance for face recognition applications.

articleTitle: AI Driven Eyeball Tracked Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Quadriplegia is a condition of complete paralysis that affects a person. The main cause of quadriplegia is an injury to the spinal cord of the human body. Various techniques are designed to help the disabled with complete paralysis to carry out their daily activities easily and one of these is the smart wheelchair. So we propose an electric wheelchair that can be controlled by tracking the movement of eyeball. Four gazes of the eyeball are tracked to control the proposed wheelchair. The left, right and center position of eyeball controls the leftward, rightward and forward motion of the wheelchair and forced blinking of eye gives the stop signal to the wheelchair. The right or left oriented continuous eyeball movement controls the backward motion of wheelchair. Firstly, the camera captures the real-time image and sends to Raspberry Pi. The Raspberry Pi process the image using computer vision and machine learning techniques and the output signal is transmitted to the Bluetooth module in the wheelchair. Then the signal is detected by the A Tmega1608 and the corresponding instruction is given to the motor drive. Accordingly the gear motor moves in accordance with the programmed direction. OpenCV and MediaPipe library are used to detect facial landmarks and track the eyeball movement from the captured frames. This AI enabled wheelchair tracking system will outperform the existing techniques.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Sign Language Processing: A Focus on IoT-Based, Hybrid, and Vision-Based Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Deaf and hard-of-hearing persons utilize sign language, a visual language. Technology development is crucial for improving communication between sign language users and non-users. Approaches that are IoT-based, hybrid, and vision-based have the potential to increase the precision, sturdiness, and accessibility of systems that process sign language. The most recent developments in IoT-based, hybrid, and vision-based sign language processing are presented in this literature review study. We highlight the potential uses of these technologies and examine the benefits and drawbacks of each strategy. Sensors and other devices are used by IoT-based sign language processing systems to gather information about the user's signs. The user may receive feedback from this data or it may be used to recognize and translate sign language gestures. IoT-based strategies are combined with other methodologies, such as deep learning and rule-based reasoning, in hybrid sign language processing systems. Computer vision techniques are used by vision-based sign language processing systems to identify and translate sign language motions from video pictures. The way sign language users interact with non-users could be completely transformed by IoT-based, hybrid, and vision-based sign language processing systems. These technologies have the potential to increase sign language's inclusivity and accessibility while also enhancing the lives of those who use it.

articleTitle: A Time Efficient Approach to Data Compression for LZW Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: This paper introduces an efficient data compression algorithm, which performs better then available LZW algorithm. Here, we propose a modified way to update the dictionary for LZW algorithm. First, we identify the different characters in the file and count the number of times each character is repeated. Then we arrange them in descending order based on the repetition count, and delete all remaining unused characters from the dictionary till 255. The proposed algorithm has shown to reduce the compression time by almost six times of the original time taken by conventional Lempel-Ziv-Welch (LZW) algorithm. The Proposed algorithm can compress data faster than conventional LZW in a single level-based operation, so it leaves an opportunity for future research by adding one more level of compression to further improve the compression rate. Its time performance in single level is better than conventional LZW.

articleTitle: SmRM: Ensemble Learning Devised Solution for Smart Riskware Management in Android Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: An ever-increasing number of malicious software programs are creating code to attack vulnerabilities in Android Machines due to the widespread adoption of Android-based devices among consumers. It is anticipated that this growth in the usage of Android machines will move in the forward direction at a high rate. An adversary may easily get into machines that are running the Android operating system since there are a large number of available security apps, many of which are not allowed, and there is a substantial risk that sensitive data will be compromised. Using ensemble learning, SmRM, the Ensemble Learning is a cutting-edge riskware identification and mitigation methodology that is proposed in this research paper. To identify and get rid of riskware risks, SmRM Ensemble Learning employs machine learning, behavioural analysis, and signature-based techniques. In this research work, the idea proposed research methodology employ application to early detect riskware attacks on android machine by getting intelligence from a machine learning-trained model to determine whether or not the data packet is malicious. The results prove that ensemble learning with maximum depth 4, gets improved results in terms of ROC Curve, recall, precision and F1 score for identifying attack packets and benign packets through traffic patterns.

articleTitle: Decoupling Control Using Linear Extended State Observer for Pitch Control of a Satellite Launch Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: A launch vehicle, also known as a powered space vehicle, is utilized to transport a spacecraft beyond Earth's atmosphere. Its mission is to reach either Earth's orbit or another destination in outer space. However, during the launch vehicle's operation, spurious dynamics can occur, which can negatively impact the performance of its control system. These dynamics are typically manifested in various ways, including kinematic coupling terms resulting from the interaction between different channels, coupling caused by aerodynamic forces between channels, and coupling through the control configuration. The uncertainty introduced by these dynamics can be effectively addressed by employing a linear extended state observer, which is designed to decouple the uncertainty. To validate its efficacy, a comparison is made with a robust sliding mode control, which handles uncertainty in its own way. The unaddressed coupling of these dynamics poses a significant threat to flight safety. Therefore, it is imperative to study and develop a decoupling control strategy using the suggested method of the linear extended state observer.

articleTitle: Real-time case study on monitoring the air quality, time delay, and fuel consumption by vehicles during flyover construction
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The real-time case study is carried out in the flyover construction of Periyanaickenpalayam. The major issues during the construction of the flyover are high traffic congestion; traveling distance is more due to the diversion of roads. Emissions from automobiles are often responsible for a significant cause of air pollution, and the emission causes more health-related issues. The quality of air has been affected by various factors like Carbon Monoxide (CO), Carbon Dioxide (CO2), Particulate Matter (PM), sulphur dioxide (SO2), Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2), Ozone (O3), and Lead (Pb) make up the emission levels composition. To control the emission level of pollutants, continuous monitoring of the vehicles and the level of toxic gases released to the environment must be monitored utilizing Air Quality Index (AQI). The Periyanaickenpalayam flyover construction started in December 2020, with 1.850km long, 17.2m wide, and the total cost provided by the Government is 115 crore. The flyover will start near Ramakrishna Mission Vidyalaya and ends at the Vannankovil area with 48 spans. The real-time case study is carried out by taking surveys from the people who travel by the diversion route daily. The particulate matter is monitored during the morning and evening peak traffic hours by PM 2.5, PM 10, and AQI sensors. The time delay calculation is based on diversifying vehicles going and coming on the road. The fuel consumption of vehicles is also monitored due to the diversion in the streets by mileage testing bottles. The data extracted from the selected flyover construction site using a mileage testing bottle is analyzed in humps and dumps roads and compared with the free stretch road. The case study evaluation is based on AQI, time delay calculation, and fuel consumption of vehicles in humps and dumps roads.

articleTitle: Torque-Ripple Minimization for Brushless DC Motor Based Upon Cuk-Converter Using Hysteresis Current Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In the medical field application, the wheelchair facilities are commonly used for people who suffer in walking. Here this, project concentrates the working model of BLDCM, converter circuitry design of automated wheelchair and cruise controlling of BLDCM and also to suppress the torque disturbance of Brushless DC motor based upon Cuk-converter using Mode Switching Circuit (MSC) with the support of Hysteresis Current Control (HCC). To enhance the usage capacity of converter, here the Cuk-converter is provided. The Cuk-converter has two output modes which is categorized into boost and buck-boost technique. During the period of commutation, Cukconverter shoot up the voltage of the inverter circuit and provide the necessary voltage for the operation. During the normal period of commutation Cuk-converter works in the buck-boost technique by performing with help of amplitude modulation method. In the conventional pulse duration or width modulation method, speed is controlled by varying the three phase inverter voltage at low speed. To attain the higher speed usage of BLDCM drive unit with Cuk-converter using hysteresis current control method is more effective for reducing torque-noise. The advantage of using hysteresis current control method which reduces the heat produces in the inverter three phase circuit, current sensing range can be narrowed and mechanical vibration can be solved. The Simulink/Matlab platform is used to analyse the torque ripple percentage values from the graphical characteristics and also the minimization of torque ripple based on Cuk-converter in BLDCM using hysteresis current control (HCC) method also done in this project.

articleTitle: A Common Ground Bridgeless Buck Boost PFC Converter with positive DC output Voltage Based On board Bi directional charger for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: This paper provides a new battery charger for electric vehicles which employs common ground bidirectional on board (EVs) with positive DC output voltage, focusing on Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) and Grid-to-Vehicle (G2V), Technological technology that connects vehicles to homes. Due to their extensive use in EVs, on-board chargers (OBCs) requirements increase because it has cost-effectiveness and ease of installation. As a result of the vehicle's small interior and quick charging time, OBC will be extremely effective and power-dense. Here, a all-purpose dual-stage common ground on-board charger is modeled that works well over a wide variety of input and positive or negative DC output voltages. The first stage is a common ground bidirectional buck boost converter. It has provide positive DC output voltage and also reduces EMI common mode filtering. Second stage is Isolated Bidirectional filter in built DC-DC Converter to offer galvanic isolation, and controls battery current to make sure batteries are charged and discharged safely.

articleTitle: RCS Reduction Techniques: A Comparative Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: RCS reduction has become prominent in the field of stealth technology. The primary design criterion for aircraft design is to increase survivability by decreasing detectability. The radar cross section (RCS) of a target is the equivalent area seen by radar. The RCS value indicates how easily an object will be detected by the radar. RCS has been reduced using approaches such as shaping, radar absorbent material (RAM), passive cancellation, and active cancellation. Because of the low RCS, the sidelobe level rises due to radiation from higher-order harmonics. This study describes an overview of current passive RCSR techniques for a variety of applications including frequency selective surface (FSS), electronic bandgap materials (EBG), split ring resonator (SRR), and complementary split ring resonator (CSRR). An extensive comparison chart is obtained based on antenna size, RCSR, gain, and the operating band for different types of techniques. Challenges and the scope of future research are also proposed in this review.

articleTitle: Space Invariant Artificial Neural Network based Prediction of human activity of Knee joints
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Human action recognition is a difficult problem that is being actively studied by the computer vision field. Human activity recognition is identifying human activities inside a digital image or video. Technologies like those used for monitoring the elderly and detecting intruders or unusual objects in public have made the strengths of artificial intelligence, and deep learning in particular, readily obvious. This research proposes employing wearable sensors to identify human activity, or Identification of Human Activity (IHA), to identify joint and knee replacement problems in older people. This research thus focuses on image-based IHA, seeks to understand more about knee replacement, and uses deep learning algorithms to recognize common human actions captured by sensing cameras, placing these devices at the cutting edge of technological advancements in consumer products. Personal impedance analysis may be used to assess practicability in several contexts.

articleTitle: Music Genre Classification Using Attention-Based CNN-Feature Fusion Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In order to organise the enormous music collections available on the Internet, genre hierarchies are widely used. Automatic musical genre classification, which may supplement or even replace the human user in this process, would substantially assist music information retrieval systems. A framework for developing and evaluating features for any content-based analysis of musical signals is also provided by automatically categorising musical genres. The paper's primary goal is to demonstrate how audio signals may be automatically classified using two models into a hierarchy of musical genres. Two feature sets are recommended for expressing timbral texture and rhythmic content, respectively. The CNN model with attention, which uses the fusion of timbral and rhythmic features, has the highest classification accuracy of 85%.

articleTitle: Advancements in CNN Architectures for Computer Vision: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Over time, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have established themselves as robust and influential tool in a variety of computer vision tasks, including image classification and object detection. The comprehensive review paper presents an in-depth analysis and comparison of recent advancements in CNN architectures for computer vision applications by providing a thorough examination of 21 state-of-the-art CNN architectures, such as LeNet-5, AlexNet, ZFNet, VGGNet, NiN, GoogleNet (Inception v1), ResNet, DCGAN, Inception v2/v3, SqueezeNet, MobileNet v1, Xception, ResNeXt, DenseNet, ShuffleNet v1, SENet, Inception v4, MobileNet v2, ShuffleNet v2, MobileNet v3, and GhostNet. Each architecture is critically evaluated based on its design principles, architectural components, suitability for various computer vision tasks, applications where these architectures have shown exceptional performance and discussions of their advantages and limitations. This review aims to provide guidance to both researchers and practitioners in the selection of the most suitable architecture for addressing specific computer vision challenges. The insights gleaned from this analysis can contribute to the ongoing research and development of CNN architectures, propelling the advancement of computer vision systems and encouraging the creation of systems that are not only more robust but also more efficient.

articleTitle: Checkout System and Payload Simulator for PAPA Payload in Aditya-L1 Mission
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Plasma Analyser Package for Aditya - L1 (PAPA) mission aims at studying the composition of solar wind and its energy distributions. Parallel to PAPA payload development, a ground-based checkout system was designed and developed for all ground level testing and calibration of payload before integrating it to satellite. Due to parallel development of payload and checkout system, all the requirements of checkout system were not frozen at the beginning; Due to this there was a need for the developed checkout system to be modular and re-configurable with minimum development time. Checkout system was designed and developed using PCI eXtensions for Instrumentation (PXIe) platform and LabVIEW software. A PXIe platform was chosen since it provides the required modularity of design and portability. LabVIEW software is chosen for ease of development and re-configurability. Queued event-based producer/consumer design pattern was used to design and implement the checkout software. PAPA payload needs high level of vacuum for payload operations due to its internal bias voltages in the range of kilo volts. Therefore, the checkout system needs to monitor the vacuum level and command the payload accordingly to avoid damaging payload while testing. To cater to this and other special requirements extensive error handling algorithms, various interlocks, and vacuum monitoring interlock are implemented in the checkout software. A PAPA payload simulator was designed and developed to test and evaluate the adequacy of the checkout system and to correct and optimize the checkout software before it is used for testing PAPA payload. PAPA payload was successfully tested and calibrated using the developed checkout system. This paper describes the design and features of the checkout system and PAPA payload simulator.

articleTitle: Effect of Observer Gain Values on Active Disturbance Rejection Control: A Practical Study in Mechatronic Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In recent decades, practitioners and industrialists have shown considerable interest in the implementation of robust control strategies for mechatronic applications. As the system complexity increases, it becomes necessary for researchers to devise control techniques that are less dependent on the detailed mathematical models of the system and are robust against unknown system dynamics and external disturbances. Active Disturbance Rejection Control (ADRC) is one such technique that is adopted in mechatronic applications, primarily due to its simplicity of design and implementation, and robustness. ADRC uses an Extended State Observer (ESO) to actively estimate and compensate for the model uncertainties and external disturbances, which makes this feedback control more robust and less dependent on a mathematical model of the system. In this study, we investigate the effect of ESO gain values on ADRC performance in mechatronic systems using a DC servo motor, which is at core of the most mechatronic systems. Additionally, we explore the manipulation of observer settling time, particularly pertinent for systems with rapid dynamics. These findings can guide the development of more efficient and reliable mechatronic systems that can operate in the presence of disturbances and uncertainties. Moreover, this study empirically supports ADRC theory by validating the influence of observer gain values on system performance.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Detection using image segmentation and Machine Learning approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The most prevalent cancer in women worldwide is breast cancer. A better outlook and lower mortality rates depend on early detection. Machine learning algorithms have recently demonstrated encouraging results in assisting breast cancer detection. This abstract seeks to give a summary of the research on machine learning algorithms for breast cancer detection. Various machine learning methods, such as artificial neural networks, support vector machines, and random forests, among others, have been used in a number of studies. Mammography image and patients data are used to train these algorithms, which can reliably predict the presence of breast cancer. The findings of these studies suggest that machine learning methods can support the highly accurate, sensitive, and specific detection of breast cancer. These algorithms can also recognise features and trends. Some algorithms might perform well on specific datasets but struggle to generalize to different populations or diverse patient demographics. This can limit their applicability in real-world scenarios. Image segmentation methods are employed to isolate the region of interest (ROI) containing potential abnormalities. To identify the key-points we compared two feature extraction algorithms SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform), ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF)

articleTitle: Copyright and privacy protection for digital music with the implementation of distributed ledger technology and deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The presence of music in our daily lives is ubiquitous. Digital musical works are created utilizing Distributed Ledger Technology and Deep learning, with their creation serving as a case study for the exploration of computerized computation, analysis of copyright, and online music administration. The problems of copyright validity and code safety are not yet fully handled in digital music. This study proposes the Digital Music Copyright and Protection (DMCP) model to analyze digital music's legal protection and management. Two-stage deep learning and distributed ledger technology are used to implement DMCP in digital music production. With the automated structure and deployment of neural network-based approaches geared toward deep learning, the Deep Neural Network (DNN) is launched. Blockchain technology improvement examines the problems with traditional copyright rights and digital music administration. Digital music copyright and protection now incorporate blockchain, which fully accounts for ownership, usage rights, and security. The DMCP concept provides the highest level of security available by combining automated computers, digital music, and distributed ledger technology. The experimental outcomes of the proposed methodology have improved prediction accuracy, music quality, music sustain ability, and copyright protection.

articleTitle: Study of the contextual factors of a project affecting the build performance in Continuous Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Continuous Integration (CI) has a significant and substantial impact on software engineering. CI optimize the development processes, enhance the code quality and facilitate a collaborative environment resulting in the effective release of high quality software features to the end users. The performance and outcome of CI build is a major concern in CI environment. In this paper we address the impact of contextual factors of software projects that can influence the performance of build in Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipeline. We studied 588 large-scale GitHub projects that uses the Travis CI build system. An experimental study is conducted on these projects to leverage the history of prior build success and failures. Three ML models are trained on the data. The aim of the study was to identify the contextual factors of a project, influencing the performance of build. We used Logistic Regression, Decision Tree and Extreme Gradient Boost model to predict the build outcome. We identified that the contextual factors has a significant impact and the study will further helps to develop techniques to preemptively detect when a CI build environment is most likely to trigger a failure.

articleTitle: A Review of Modern Authentication Methods in Digital Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In today's world, the traditional way of password based authentication is having limitations in addressing the security concerns of the digital users. There is a strong movement in favour of passwordless authentication to secure our cyber identities and digital assets. In the recent years, a lot of research outputs have been published in the field of authentication with techniques like multifactor authentication, passwordless authentication, adaptive authentication and continuous authentication. Not only the user, but also the device, the application etc. must be authenticated to access the resources, facilities and services. Even though the passwords face some serious security issues, they enjoy considerable user acceptance and hence some schemes termed as semi-passwordless authentication are also prevalent. This paper goes through existing authentication schemes, their security issues, attacks and the next step ahead.

articleTitle: Fusing Deep CNN and Local Binary Pattern for Accurate Plant Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In today's world where the demand for food in-creases exponentially, a major thrift has occurred in the agri-culture industry to plant those seeds which are convenient and hassle-free to grow. Plants which have the possibility of being infected and which are difficult to cultivate are generally left behind. This in turn will lead to surplus amount of a certain commodity whereas produce scarcity for the others. Moreover, it will affect the economy as a whole. One of the major reasons for this shift is the lack of knowledge and expertise to tackle the unfamiliar diseases that occur in their cultivation. Farmers that are planting new crops with no prior experience will need proper expertise to identify diseases and their treatments for a better yield. But in the present scenario that will have severe overhead costs and thus culminates a lot of risk for the cultivator. In this scenario, an easy to use software that can analyse the issue and give a likeable solution is much desired. Hence, we propose our idea on Leaf Disease Classification and Remedies which can analyse the disease present and suggest probable remedies as well. Our system is built on the traditionally available CNN Models trained on the Field Plant data set to give a better accuracy of the in-field images. During identification, if the possibility of disease is above a threshold then a warning for the same is given. A locally-procured database consisting of treatments for various diseases were made to provide information to users about the identified diseases. And we have also incorporated a predictive analysis system which can (to some extend) give an idea about any possible chances of infection.

articleTitle: Fibonacci Series Based 21 Level Switched Capacitor Inverter Topology Using Hysteresis Band
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Single phase transformer less inverter with multi level AC output is proposed and discussed in this paper. Recent applications, switched capacitor inverters are used widely for high efficiency and less losses. A 21 level output voltage is generated using switched capacitor topology with the components of 2 flying capacitors, 8 switches and 2 diodes is designed. Proposed inverter is configured by charging and discharging of capacitors based on hysteresis bandwidth. These capacitors are charged to reach 21 levels of output voltage magnitude by Fibonacci series of count 8. i.e., (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, and 8). The switched capacitor mulitlevel inverter (SCMLI) with symmetric multi band hysteresis current control (MBHCC) is used to control switches by multiphase pulse generation. The 21-level output voltage is achieved by comparing the reference current and the load current. Simulated results obtained are used to validate the strategy, and different load is considered and analysed each stages of SCMLI.

articleTitle: An Efficient Battery Management System for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Electrochemical power sources have been the subject of extensive study. These resources have indirectly benefited the nation's economy and are anticipated to be crucial in a variety of applications going forward. The Li-ion battery is a particularly wise choice among many power sources for many applications because of its higher cell voltage, high volumetric energy, low weight, and extended life. The disadvantages of modern Li-ion batteries include capacity loss, a rise in internal resistance, and the potential for thermal runaway as they age. Due to the usage of Li-ion batteries as a power source, particularly for automotive applications, ageing of these batteries has been a major problem (EVs, HEVs). This study adds to the efforts being made to understand the mechanism of battery ageing using mathematical modelling and simulation. The suggested Li-ion battery solution offers better performance, longer battery cycle life, and risk-free operation.

articleTitle: Handwritten Text Recognition Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: “HANDWRITING RECOGNITION” has generated a lot of attention in the realms of pattern recognition and machine learning due to its applicability in a variety of disciplines. Both optical character recognition (OCR) and hand-written character recognition (HCR) have a defined operation sphere. In the near future, character recognition technology may be essential for exercising and digitising paper documents in order to create a paperless environment. This action categorises each handwritten word in order to convert handwritten notes into digital form. Input text or photos are directly identified by handwriting; many automated process systems also look at these materials. Numerous sorts of handwritten characters, such as integers, figures, cursive notation, symbols, and scripts in various languages have emerged as a result of the development of handwriting. In multitudinous situations where it's necessary to exercise large amounts of handwritten data, analogous as the identification of addresses and postcodes on envelopes, the interpretation of amounts on bank checks, document analysis, and hand verification, automatic recognition of handwritten text can be truly helpful. therefore, a computer is demanded in order for document processing to be as simple as possible.

articleTitle: Efficient Real Time Stator Inter-Turn Short Circuit Fault Detection of Inverter-Fed Induction Motors: A Hybrid Approach Utilizing Wavelet Transform and Digital Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In induction motors faults in the stator winding can significantly impact their performance and reliability. This research investigates the analysis of inter-turn short circuit faults by varying the switching frequency of the sine pulse-width modulation (PWM) inverter under different loading conditions. A faulty condition of the motor is modeled in MATLAB/Simulink blocks, and stator currents are simulated for different fault percentages. First, the wavelet transform is applied to decompose the stator current signals into different frequency sub bands. Next, statistical parameters are computed from the wavelet coefficients to quantify the characteristics of the stator current signals. These statistical parameters can include mean, standard deviation, variance, skewness, kurtosis, or other measures that capture the statistical properties of the wavelet coefficients. This Statical data is used to train the SVM model and find a optimal decision boundary to classify Healthy or Faulty Condition.

Author Keywords: Induction motor driven by an inverter

articleTitle: Depth Sensing and Object Localization Using Ultrasound 2D Traversing Scanner
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Imaging is an inevitable part of modern medicine. Imaging is normally the process of obtaining images using light waves. It can also be obtained by electronically tracing something such as sound waves, temperature, and chemicals. Different types of medical imaging procedures include X-rays, Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), Ultrasound, Endoscopy, Computerized tomography, etc. Ultrasound is a widely used imaging technology worldwide due to its non-ionizing nature, speed, and less attenuation by body tissues. In this paper we propose an affordable ultrasound system that gives a 3D profile of surfaces by acquiring the ultrasound echoes from the surfaces. This proposed system comprises of HC-SR04 transducer, a high-frequency data acquisition device (NI-myDAQ), and a microcontroller (Arduino) enabling the acquisition of 3D surface profiles and determination of the shape of an object. The data acquisition of the proposed system was carried out using Matlab software. The acquired Ultrasound echo is similar to an A-scan in Ultrasound imaging.

articleTitle: Disease Detection & Classification of Maize Leaves Using Fusion Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: This presented research aims to combine the ResNet18 transfer learning model with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to revolutionize the identification and classification of diseases in maize leaves. For the security of the world's food supply, it is critical to maintain the health of maize plants as a vital staple crop. Traditional disease detection techniques take a long time and are prone to mistakes. Our research uses deep learning and digital image processing to produce a more precise and practical approach. The primary objective of this research is to build a solid model capable of correctly recognizing and categorizing various maize leaf diseases. The basis of this research is a dataset with 4188 labelled photos of healthy maize leaves and maize leaves with three different disease kinds. For objective model assessment, this dataset is methodically divided into training, validation, and test batches. The recommended approach entails turning detailed visual information into useful feature vectors by employing a CNN to extract intricate characteristics from maize leaf photos. The ResNet18 model is then trained on the dataset for maize leaf disease using these vectors as input. This combination of CNN and ResNet18 uses CNN's skill in feature extraction and ResNet18's expertise in specialized categorisation. Training, validation, and testing steps are all included in the thorough examination of performance. Accuracy and loss graphs are used to track training and validation, giving information about the model's convergence and learning pattern. A confusion matrix is derived during the testing phase, from which crucial metrics like Accuracy are produced. The results demonstrate the power of the fusion model, which successfully classified diseases with a remarkable 96% accuracy. This result highlights the possibility of utilizing cutting-edge image processing techniques to improve crop management procedures and reduce losses brought on by diseases. Ultimately, our research adds to the expanding body of knowledge examining the relationship between agriculture and technology by providing a fresh perspective on pressing issues relating to crop health and global food security.

articleTitle: Loan Default Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques and Deep Learning ANN Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Loan default prediction is a critical task in the financial sector, aimed at assessing the creditworthiness of borrowers and minimizing potential losses for lending institutions. Online loans continue to reach the public spotlight as Internet technology develops, and this trend is expected to continue in the foreseeable future. In this paper, the authors proposed loan default loan prediction system based on ML and DL models. This work makes use of the information on loan defaults provided by Lending Club. The dataset is preprocessed by applying various data preprocessing techniques and preprocessed dataset is generated. Later, we proposed four ML algorithms decision tree, random forest, logistic regression, K-NN and Feed forward neural network. The experimental results shown that proposed feed forward neural network achieved good accuracy for loan default prediction with an accuracy of 99%.

articleTitle: Rectangular Patch Antenna with DGS Based on Integral Appolonian Circle Packing
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In this paper, a rectangular microstrip patch antenna(MPA) has been designed to resonate at a frequency of 5.2 GHz. Rectangular patch antennas support only a single frequency of operation. The working of the MPA in terms of multiband operation can be improved by introducing Defected Ground Structures(DGS). In this work, a DGS based on Integral Appolonian Circle Packing is introduced into the antenna structure and its performance evaluated. Beginning with four mutually tangent circles, we can go on adding newer circles that are tangential to three of the previous circles by means of Apollonius theorem. This process can be repeated indefinitely to arrive at an infinite circle packing known an Apollonian circle packing. In integeral Appolonian cirlce packing, all the four mutually tangential circles of the Apollonian circle packing have an integer curvature. In this work. we are studying the performance improvement in the patch antenna when Integral Appolonian circle packing of curvature (-1,2,2,3) is introduced as DGS in the antenna structure. Upto three generation of the Appolonian circle packing has been simulated using OpenEMS. It has been observed that the first generation of the Appolonian circle packing resonates at three frequencies, namely 2.5 GHz, 4.1 GHz and 6.8 GHz,

articleTitle: Smart Embedded Design for Android Application Based Control of Self Balancing Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Self balancing robot is considered to be an important development in the field of mobile robot platform. This paper presents the design of smart embedded system for controlling the direction and speed of stepper motor driving the self balanced robot. The control of speed and direction of stepper motor is very critical to ensure the stability of two-wheeled robot. The stability of two-wheeled robot is ensured by maintaining the upright walking position. The proposed smart embedded system is designed to perform sensing, control and actuation. The hardware and software co-design allows the control of self-balancing robot using an Android device.

articleTitle: Classification of Neurological Disorders from EEG using Deep Learning Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: EEG has been determined to be the optimum method for detecting the majority of regularly occurring brain disorders. The typical EEG based diagnosis for brain disorders is manual and time demanding. The EEG of individuals varies depending on the circumstances surrounding their health. The paper proposes a system for analyzing EEG waves and detecting specified patterns in them in order to diagnose certain biomedical conditions like epilepsy, insomnia, Alzheimer's, and intracranial haemorrhage. For the purpose of the aforementioned goal, ma-chine learning and deep learning algorithms are employed, and a comparison between these models is carried out. Implementation of VI as the front end to the algorithms is also described.

articleTitle: Companion: A Convenient Mobile Application For School Students Attendance, Registration, Notice, Bus Schedule, Complaint, and Parent Alert Services
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: By educating students and preparing them for the future job market, schools play a crucial role in their lives. Attendance taking, course registration, fee collection, class schedules, notices, exam results publication, parent alerts, midday meals, and complaint inspection services are among the fundamental school-related tasks. The existing work on school-related services is provided offline, which is costly in terms of both time and money. By considering issues like attendance, registration, school fee payment, notification, class schedule, bus schedule publication, parent alert, and complaint services, there is a lack of practical online-based assistance systems and applications for school children in Bangladesh. The research problem of how to assist schoolchildren by developing a mobile app with multiple features is missing in the literature. This paper delivers a convenient mobile app for aiding schoolchildren in resolving these current challenges. The proposed online-based mobile application includes features like attendance taking and checking, course registration, school fee payment, daily parent alerts, bus schedules, exam/class schedule notifications, exam result checking, and compliant facilities. The application rating analysis revealed that more than 62% of reviewers are satisfied with the app's design, and more than 65% of reviewers gave commendable comments regarding the planned app features.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Assisted Improved Design to Predict Brain Tumor on Earlier Stages using Deep Learning Principle
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Brain- Tumors are the second most common reason of cancer today. Numerous people are at risk from cancer. The medical community requires a rapid, automated, efficient, and trustworthy method for detecting tumors, such as brain tumors. Early diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment. If a tumor can be detected early enough, medical professionals can remove the patient from harm's way. This research makes use of novel image processing and deep learning method to predict the brain tumor in an intelligent manner with the power of AI, which is called as Supportive Intelligence for Tumor Detection (SITD). Numerous tumor patients have been saved thanks to this app's accurate diagnosis and therapy. Unchecked cell growth constitutes a tumor's defining feature. As brain tumor cells multiply, they starve healthy brain cells and tissues of the nutrition they need to survive. When trying to locate a tumor in a patient's brain, neurosurgeons must now review MR pictures manually. The goal of this research was to compile a comprehensive literature evaluation on the use of MRI to detect brain cancers for future investigation. This research looked at how advanced learning, transferable learning, and quantum computer learning may be used to analyze brain tumors. Topics included brain tumor anatomy, publically available datasets, augmentation approaches, segmentation, feature extraction, classification and more. The resulting section shows the outcome efficiency of the proposed approach SITD by means of following metrics such as: Training-and- Testing Accuracy, Training-and- Testing Loss.

articleTitle: Enhanced Deep Learning Approach for Software Defect Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In the realm of defect prediction in complex systems, the integration of advanced machine learning techniques holds promise for enhancing accuracy and efficiency. This research introduces a novel approach by combining a Deep Adaptive Neural Network (ARNN) with the optimization capabilities of Cuckoo Search (CSO) for defect and non-defect data classification. Th e proposed model leverages the temporal dependencies within the data using a deep ARNN architecture, allowing for the exploration of intricate patterns and correlations over time. To optimize the model's performance, the Cuckoo Search Optimization algorithm is employed. CSO, inspired by the reproductive behavior of cuckoos, offers an effective mechanism for fine-tuning the parameters of the deep ARNN, optimizing its ability to discern subtle variations between defect and non-defect instances. The efficacy of the proposed approach is evaluated on benchmark datasets, showcasing its capability to achieve superior predictive accuracy compared to conventional methods.

articleTitle: Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The FRBM Act was enacted by the Indian government to address the issue of fiscal deficit and its negative impact on the Indian economy. It aimed to promote and encourage the proper management of public finances by setting targets for reducing the fiscal deficit and outstanding debt. But most of the states in India do not follow this completely. This affects the economic stability of the states and the country. There are currently no systems in place to measure the extent to which individual states are complying with this. This paper proposes a new algorithm called FRBM Clustering. It is possible to use this algorithm to rank the state governments on the basis of how far different states in India have progressed in implementing the directives under the FRBM act. The state governments can be ranked using the information released by the Reserve Bank of India from time to time and the budget documents of the state governments with the help of this clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning: Algorithms to balance the bias between Exploration and Exploitation
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Reinforcement learning agents map states to optimal actions by developing a policy. In order to learn which of the available actions yields the highest rewards, the agent makes decisions from the available actions. As a result, by choosing the most obvious action to take on each action decision, a Reinforcement Learning agent maximizes its reward. Nevertheless, in order to gain a complete understanding of how favorable each action is, it must explore all the options. Exploration and exploitation are at odds in this area. This bias is balanced by numerous existing algorithms. Epsilon-Greedy Approaches, Optimistically High Initial Value Approaches, and Upper Confidence Bounds Approaches are a few of these techniques. Using the K-Armed Bandit problem as a simulation, this paper compares these algorithms, their benefits and disadvantages. Research suggests that maximizing long-term rewards will require a combination of these methods. Simulations are run to examine the impact of altering the epsilon parameter, and performance changes are noted with decreasing the epsilon parameter within convergence.

articleTitle: Dual Cloud Bibliographic Network Model for Citation Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Finding relevant and appropriate papers for citation is becoming more and more difficult for researchers as a result of the exponential growth in the number of scientific papers. To tackle this problem, citation recommendations have been developed, aiming to provide a curated selection of relevant reference papers tailored to a specific manuscript. Citation recommendation algorithms could raise privacy concerns, particularly when working with sensitive or personal data. In this paper, we propose a dual cloud-based bibliographic network representation (BNR) model for effective recommendation and to ensure data protection. The BNR model in the proposed work deals with the relationships, paper-to-paper, paper-author, paper-key terms, etc. The system is evaluated with academic corpus namely ACM, AAN, and DBLP. The system proposes a privacy-preserved BNR citation recommendation approach that outperforms previous citation recommendation approaches by a wide margin.

articleTitle: Dip Into: A Novel Method for Visual Speech Recognition using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Visual speech Recognition is a method of understanding speech that allows for visual interpretation of speech sounds. Though most people who have normal hearing process some voice information from the sight of the moving mouth, Visual Speech Recognition is most commonly employed by those who are deaf or hard of hearing. Additionally, conversing clearly in loud surroundings can be improved by comprehending the linguistic clues of visual speech recognition systems. By utilizing the inherent existence of audio and visual streams in videos, a model for identifying the effects of intermodal self-monitoring for speech reconstruction (video-audio) is proposed in this paper. The model, which does not require human annotation, utilizes an attention architecture and an autoregressive encoder-decoder. For the purpose of reconstructing speech, we directly map silent face movement sequences to mel-scale spectrograms.

articleTitle: Investigation of Ensemble Learning Approach for Early Detection of Traffic from Tor Browser
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In this research paper, ensemble learning is used to create a new paradigm for network security. This study's main goal is to detect and prevent malicious communication from entering network setups, in the campus area network The dark web, often known as the “dark net,” is an encrypted portion of the internet that cannot be accessed without specific permission or settings and is not included in search engine results. People that need privacy do soon the dark web for totally lawful reasons, despite the fact that it is often depicted as a space utilized by criminal groups, such as the transmission of secret company information or communication by political activists. In order to secure user identity and ensure anonymity, the dark net encryption technology transmits users' data via a huge number of intermediary servers. The Tor Browser is a web browser created with the goal of increasing online privacy and anonymity. It is based on the Tor network, a decentralized system of volunteer-run servers that routes internet infrastructure across several nodes to obfuscate the user's IP address and make it challenging to monitor their online activity. It may not provide full security against all dangers. The study in this area enhances network security and safety via the application of advanced machine learning. Through the detection of possible flaws and trend analysis of Tor use, this study aims to improve network security. Several different machine learning methods are combined to assess the intricate network traffic patterns. With the ability to quickly identify deviations from the standard, the computer can identify fake data and facilitate proactive intervention. The great degree of precision of ensemble learning demonstrated its efficacy. The network security techniques that might be employed to protect open networks from attacks are improved by this study.

articleTitle: Development of Guidance Algorithm for Planetary Landing
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In the field of space science and exploration, the Moon and Mars hold significant importance as destinations. When it comes to a planetary soft landing mission, a crucial requirement is for the space exploration vehicle to touch down on the surface with no relative velocities. Achieving this challenging feat is made possible by employing a fixed thrust motor and applying optimal control theory. The primary aim of this research is to develop a power descent guidance algorithm, both in open and closed-loop configurations, ensuring efficient guidance for soft landings and validating its effectiveness. As an initial step, Using predetermined performance specifications, a three-dimensional open-loop analysis is explored. Subsequently, the validity of three-dimensional open-loop guidance is verified. To overcome the limitations that may be associated with external disturbances, plant uncertainty and so forth in open-loop guidance, a closed-loop guidance algorithm using the Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) approach is employed. The closed-loop guidance using LQR is analyzed. MATLAB simulations are conducted to verify the obtained results.

articleTitle: Malayalam TTS Using Tacotron2, WaveGlow and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Text-to-speech (TTS) systems have become an essential component in various applications, such as virtual assistants, audiobook production, and accessibility tools. However, developing TTS systems for languages with limited resources and unique phonetic characteristics poses significant challenges, especially for low-resource languages like Malayalam. This paper proposes a novel Malayalam Text-To-Speech system that uses Tacotron2, an established neural network architecture that maps character embeddings to mel-spectrograms, and WaveGlow, a flow-based network that takes mel-spectrograms as input and generates high-quality speech comparable to that of a natural human voice. Due to the scarcity of labelled data for Malayalam, transfer learning is employed to overcome the limitations of insufficient training data. Fine-tuning is performed using a smaller dataset specifically tailored for Malayalam, ensuring better language-specific representation and improved performance. To evaluate the proposed system, Mean Opinion Score (MOS) was used to assess the quality and similarity of synthesized speech to natural speech.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Strategy to Detect COVID-19 by Inspecting the Statistical Significance of Standard Deviation of Sound Samples of Healthy, Covid and Post Covid Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In the battle against COVID-19, the implementation of an automated non-invasive system for COVID-19 detection offers significant advantages. By reducing exposure risks, such a system prioritizes the safety of both healthcare workers and patients. Furthermore, it improves efficiency by streamlining the testing process, allowing for rapid and accurate results. The system provides standardized and objective assessments, eliminating the potential for human error and ensuring consistent outcomes. Additionally, it enhances patient comfort by eliminating the need for invasive procedures. This paper explores the potential of utilizing time domain features, specifically the standard deviation, extracted from different audio samples like Deep Breath, Dry Cough, Count Normal, and Vowels (a, e, and o), to detect COVID-19 cases by measuring their statistical significance. The study investigates the feature separability of different conditions using Box-Whisker plots and finds that the ‘Count normal’ audio record exhibits superior discriminative ability with ‘H’ and ‘P’ values of 32.46 and 8.943xl0-8, respectively. To evaluate the efficacy of standard deviation of ‘Count normal’ audio records in detecting COVID-19, various Support Vector Machines (SVMs) such as Linear, Quadratic, Cubic, Fine Gaussian, Medium Gaussian, and Coarse Gaussian are employed. Results indicate that the Fine Gaussian SVM outperforms other types of SVMs, achieving training and testing accuracies of 70% and 76.70%, respectively.

articleTitle: Predicting Credit Card Defaults with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Detecting credit card fraud is of paramount importance to financial institutions and credit card companies, as it plays a vital role in preventing monetary losses due to fraudulent transactions. The application of machine learning algorithms has become prevalent in this domain due to their capacity to analyze large datasets and identify patterns.
