By leveraging YOLO, the project extracts precise vehicle information from video streams, enabling comprehensive data collection for traffic analysis. Additionally, OCR algorithms automatically identify license plate numbers, facilitating law enforcement and fine estimation. This integrated approach enhances vehicle analysis, providing valuable insights for traffic optimization, infrastructure planning, and law enforcement strategies. The project aims to create safer, more efficient cities by harnessing the power of image processing techniques like YOLO and OCR in realtime vehicle analysis.

articleTitle: Analyzing Industry Information Management and limitations based on P2P computing
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The use of real-time technology is crucial in fmthe field of industrial computerization. Much speculation has been about the huge growth in sophisticated networked devices such establishments use. It's often called “Industry 4.0” or “the Industrial Internet of Things.” Many goods mean many uses, which are widely dispersed. Therefore, in real-world settings, a single device is insufficient. The impact of communication on applications' overall temporal behavior is growing. Due to this need, many Industrial Ethernet (IE) methods have been created. Successful IE countermeasures often include custom-built software or non-standard adjustments to existing protocols. It undermines interoperability and creates expensive gear incompatible with other IE or regular Ethernet alternatives. A P2P computing-based deterministic communication (P2PDC) framework is proposed in this article. P2PDC presents a P2P technique that offers a deterministic connection through standard Ethernet on a full software basis. While it does allow for real-time interactions and is based only on industry-standard protocols, it does have a few drawbacks. P2PDC's low network utilization, hash attack control, and congestion prioritization are singled out in the report as the most important limits and solutions to these problems. The experimental results show the P2PDC to achieve an accuracy ratio of 92.21 %, precision ratio of 92.65%, efficiency ratio of 89.97%, F -score ratio of 90.14%, recall ratio of 88.78% and less packet drop ratio of 33.3% compared to other methods.

articleTitle: Application of Deep neural network for an Effective user experience in an interactive platform
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The technical community is becoming more concerned with the interface between humans and machines to increase the capability of the real device to fulfill the user's expectations and improve the interpretation of human control as accurately as possible. Intelligent systems that can mold themselves to their users' characteristics need dedicated research and development. A user-controlled, interactive robot visualizer that actively searches for and brings the viewer an item they choose. As a result, this study aims to present a Deep neural network-based interactive platform (DNNIP) to enhance understanding concerning the thinking of the end user. A deep neural network (DNN) and particle filtering may estimate the user location. The robot will first use location data to navigate the user's area, then face recognition to provide service at the user's location. The artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm is a famous meta-heuristic optimization method based on how honeybees find sustenance. ABC is great at exploring low manipulation ability, low response, and high accuracy in robot interaction. Consequently, the experiments' findings demonstrate that the suggested model is a smart, more effective, and more reliable tool than conventional communication techniques.

articleTitle: Business Intelligence systems (BIS) focused on the principle of global quality improvement through data mining
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The new field of market analysis has started to create empirical investigations founded on Business Intelligence System (BIS) technology, which has garnered much interest from academics and industry professionals. However, the influence that BIS has on the general enhancement of quality and the statistical importance of this effect has not yet been investigated. As a result, in this work, the Global Quality Improvement (GQI) model has been offered as a solution to cope with the gap concentrated on an interconnected quality assurance concept of data mining on information technology and the concept of data management. A survey of executives from all over the world is being used to collect data from various firms. When implementing the BI, GQI uses the planning and assessment activities with a higher success rate. GQI efficiency, planning, and assessment are intricately related to the advancement of technology worldwide, and it is also intertwined with the efficiency of high-quality preparation with various company operations. According to the study's findings, GQI is related to the knowledge requirements of firm organizations, which might range from widespread complexity to management actions centered on misunderstanding. According to the experiment's findings, GQI appears to have the greatest efficacy compared to currently used approaches.

articleTitle: Dynamic Learning: A System for Learning Offensive Content
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In the digital era, online social networks have become an integral part of global communication. However, managing offensive language and content poses a significant challenge for these platforms. To address this issue, extensive research has focused on developing systems that can effectively detect and mitigate offensive language. This paper emphasizes two crucial aspects of offensive language detection: data preprocessing and feature selection. Data preprocessing involves removing noise, filtering out irrelevant information, and segmenting the text for analysis. Feature selection employs a fuzzy-based convolutional neural network (FCNN) to identify relevant features. Fuzzy logic handles uncertainty and ambiguity, while convolutional neural networks capture patterns and representations. By leveraging these techniques, offensive language detection systems can achieve accuracy and effectiveness, promoting a safer online environment. Continuous refinement of data preprocessing and feature selection methods contributes to the ongoing efforts to create inclusive and respectful digitalspaces.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Diagnosis of Depression Using EEG Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) emerges as a prominent factor leading to disability on a global scale and contributes significantly to the global burden of illness overall. The traditional method of detecting MDD is by continuous medical examination by a psychologist or psychiatrist. Our objective is to develop a non-invasive device which collects brain signals from the head and gets interfaced with a computer. The purpose of this paper is to develop a computer-aided diagnosis system that can identify depression in real time. The proposed system comprises three main components: the ADS1299 Front-End (FE) Printed Development Kit (PDK) evaluation board, a wearable electrode, and a desktop application. The primary approach involves the utilization of electroencephalogram (EEG) signal processing, along with the ADS1299 FE PDK evaluation board and deep learning techniques. This paper involves the utilisation of a publicly available dataset for training the deep learning model. The convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm is used for the classification process. Absolute and relative powers are computed, and an asymmetry image matrix is generated based on the relative power values. By analysing the image matrix, the system can classify a patient as healthy or suffering from major depression based on higher or lower relative power, respectively. This paper seeks to make a valuable contribution to the academic sphere of the study of mental health diagnosis by leveraging advanced signal processing techniques and deep learning models for more accurate and efficient detection of depression.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Optimization Techniques DeepLearning Models Based on Bell Pepper Leaves Diseases Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Deep learning has become a powerful tool for classifying and detecting images. In agriculture, deep learning can help organize and predict various issues, such as disease in leaves and stems, providing accurate information to farmers about various plant diseases, etc. This paper explains different optimization techniques used in deep learning, such as Rms prop, SGM, and Adam, specifically in the context of bell pepperdisease classification using Vgg 19. The study aims to analyze and improve the convergence capability of the Vgg 19 deep-learning CNN model. The study aims to determine the optimal configuration that achieves high accuracy in training, validation, and testing for disease classification in bell peppers. The work includes studying different optimizers and learning rates to find the most suitable optimizer and learning rate for the Vgg 19 CNN model in bell pepper leaf disease classification.Based on this study, the paper concludes that the Adam optimizer performs better with a small learning rate.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Nonlinear Causality: Exploring the Influence of Positive and Negative Financial News on the Indian Equity Market
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Recent attention has focused on the interplay between news media and stock prices, prompted by extensive exploration of stock market dynamics. This study is designed to examine the existence of non-linear causal links between positive and negative financial news and stock market valuations. Employing sentiment analysis, the Finbert model evaluates news content, while the Transfer Entropy method assesses the impact of both positive financial news and negative news. Investigating the causal relationships between fluctuations in positive and negative news and stock price performance across diverse companies through transfer entropy analysis, our findings confirm the evident disparity in the influence of positive and negative news on daily stock prices. Quantification of these effects adopts the Sliding Window approach. Furthermore, our evaluations indicate that negative financial news exerts a more significant influence on stock prices compared to positive financial news. These outcomes bolster the concept of an asymmetric effect, wherein negative sentiment wields a more substantial influence compared to its positive counterpart.

articleTitle: Water Tank Overflow and Low Level Indication Using Arduino and GSM
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Water tank overflow is a common issue that results in a significant amount of water wastage. While there are several solutions available, such as the installation of ball valves that automatically prevent water flow once the tank reaches full capacity, those who are tech-savvy might appreciate the use of an electronic option. Therefore, this paper describes a simple and convenient do-it-yourself solution for building a circuit that can detect the water level and notify when the water tank is full or has reached a specific preset level. Installing this circuit can help save water, reduce the risk of water damage and also prevent damage to the property due to water overflow. A water overflow detector is a device that is designed to detect water levels and alert homeowners or building managers when water levels exceed a certain threshold. These devices are important in preventing water damage in homes and buildings, as they can alert users to potential flooding and prevent costly repairs. Water overflow detectors come in different types, including standalone sensors and integrated systems that connect to smart home networks. They can be placed in specific areas, such as near washing machines or hot water heaters, or in any area where water damage is a concern. Overall, a water overflow detector is a valuable tool for anyone who wants to protect their home or building from water damage. In this paper, a novel water tank overflow and low level indication using Arduino and GSM is described.

articleTitle: Integrating Photogrammetry Technology and Smart Innovations for Heritage Structure Conservation in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Integration of photogrammetric methodologies into heritage preservation initiatives within smart urban environments has a major role in the safeguarding of cultural and historical artifacts, maintaining of longstanding customs, the promotion of tourism and the facilitation of local economic development. Temple towns situated within smart cities sometimes serve as sources for architectural marvels, elaborate sculptures and deeply built cultural traditions, each possessing invaluable significance. Within this particular setting, photogrammetry arises as a crucial instrument for the purposes of archiving, restoration and virtual reconstructions, providing an outstanding level of precision and accuracy. This study explores the utilization of photogrammetric methodologies, including aerial photography, close-range photogrammetry and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery, within the context of smart cities. The utilization of these techniques serves a variety of purposes, including the evaluation of the structural soundness, ongoing monitoring of decay, safeguarding the aesthetic and cultural value of historic structures. The challenge of achieving a harmonious balance between technical progress and the safeguarding of traditional legacy values and practices is a complex work, since it requires a critical consideration of cultural aspects. The focus of this research is to enhance our comprehension of the seamless integration of technology into smart city efforts, specifically in the context of preserving the cultural and historical heritage of temple towns in smart cities.

articleTitle: SEAFL: Transforming Federated Learning for Enhanced Privacy in 6G-Enabled Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The utilization of artificial intelligence (AI) within the 6G-enabled Internet of Vehicles (IoV) has proven to be crucial in tackling complex issues, primarily through the adoption of deep learning methodologies. However, in certain sensitive data-driven sectors like healthcare and autopilot systems, traditional centralised training raises privacy concerns. To address this, federated learning (FL) has emerged as a popular approach, enabling collaborative model learning without exposing local data. However, recent investigations have highlighted that malevolent actors can exploit shared parameters to undermine critical applications such as autonomous driving systems, medical data from wearable devices, emergency message propagation scenarios, and the decision-making processes of industrial robots. In this article, we introduce a novel and robust aggregation mechanism named Secure and Efficient Aggregation for Federated Learning (SEAFL), tailored to the context of the 6G-enabled Internet of Vehicles (IoV). This approach aims to address the increasing privacy concerns and security threats arising in the collaborative learning landscape of the IoV, where sensitive data privacy is of paramount importance. Within the context of SEAFL, we amalgamated local differential privacy (LDP) into the realm of federated learning, employing a three-tier aggregation protocol within the software-defined vehicular fog (SDVF) architecture. Leveraging the incorporation of multiple aggregation levels and a privacy budget, SEAFL enhances privacy and accuracy by iteratively perturbing and aggregating gradients, resulting in heightened privacy protection, minimised gradient exposure, preserved data integrity, improved global model accuracy, and fortified resilience against adversarial threats. Through comprehensive experiments conducted on attack datasets, SEAFL outperforms alternative FL-based Local Differential Privacy (LDP) solutions, showcasing superior performance in terms of both accuracy and efficiency. This makes SEAFL a promising approach for secure and efficient federated learning in sensitive vehicular applications like emergency message dissemination scenarios.

articleTitle: Application of Mobile Health in Mental Health Interventions
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Mobile health services may effectively mitigate the obstacles to mental health treatment due to their ability to meet people where they are and provide instant assistance. M-Health allows for modifying and facilitating psychological support for well-being when the likelihood of success is greatest. The potential translation advantages for boosting mental health must be acknowledged. Yet, insufficient delivery of mental health technologies in the present world shows that novel means of increasing the accessibility to healthcare measures are necessary. Exploratory methods like randomized trials are used to improve and modify m-health services. Evidence gathered from this method may be used to develop and improve m-health programs. The data will be utilized to establish the specific locations and types of m-health operations required to integrate accurate therapy into ordinary practice. This study proposes and discusses Mobile Mental Health Interventions (MMHI), which consider issues during an MRI and provide a manual for psychiatric intervention developers. In comparison to existing methods, the suggested MMHI performs well in simulation

articleTitle: An Automated Machine Learning NLP Model for Enhancing the Translation of English Causative Sentences into Malayalam Language
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: This research paper introduces an innovative Neural Machine Translation (NMT) model designed to accurately translate causative English sentences into Malayalam. The study comprehensively explores the various forms of causative sentences utilized in both English and Malayalam, focusing on syntactic and semantic differences. Additionally, it delves into the limitations of current translation models such as Google Translator in accurately translating causative constructs. To address these challenges and enhance translation accuracy, a collaborative effort with professional linguists in both languages led to the creation of a rich dataset. The dataset comprises a diverse collection of causative sentences, covering tense variations, singular and plural forms, noun and verb classes, as well as sentence forms involving non-human and animate-human subjects. This model integrates essential components including tokenization, Part of Speech (POS) tagging, tense identification, suffix identification and addition, and sentence reordering for improved translation. Comparative evaluations between the Google Translator and the newly developed system were conducted based on translation accuracy and fluency. The evaluation revealed that the novel NMT model consistently outperforms existing translation systems, demonstrating superior translation results. The findings underscore the effectiveness and potential of the proposed NMT model in advancing causal English to Malayalam translation, offering valuable insights for the improvement of machine translation systems.

articleTitle: Investor Behavior Analysis Using Bayesian Learning for the Equity Market
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: These days, it's crucial in financial services to analyze investor actions to ascertain consumers' choices, projections, studies, and revisions. The study of the investing process known as “behavioral finance” has shown that investors do not always act logically, as they frequently become excessively driven by their desires and can't regulate their emotions, leading to poor decisions regarding investments under pressure. This research offers Bayesian Learning-Based Investor Behavior Analysis (BLIBA) to increase profits in a new market and maintain consistency in Equity outcomes. Income shocks from changes in the stock price are the driving force behind the suggested BLIBA weights caused by conservative and reflective investors in this minimalist model of investing emotions. Using these weightings, one can establish a mathematical relationship between market anomalies and the investing preferences of individuals. The result demonstrates the importance of an investment decision on investor behaviour, Psychology Behaviour, underreaction, assurance, and the ultimate choice of the investment itself

articleTitle: Computer Network-Assisted Technology-Based English Teaching Method with Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: the increased need for well-rounded proficiency in oral, written, and read-aloud communication directly results from the recent educational revolution and its focus on education quality, particularly in English. The networked environment and the new reading model for English that it has spawned are products of the application of cutting-edge science and technology connected with teaching tools using artificial intelligence (AI). articleTitle: Workplace Safety Training for Healthcare Workers Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Training and education for medical staff is crucial to ensuring patients get the best possible treatment. Healthcare is and always has been a very technical and specialized industry. Maintaining a competent workforce and a healthy work-life balance depends on the program's effectiveness. This article details nurses' perspectives on patient safety and examines the frequency of contrasting incidents. This paper proposes the Deep learning-assisted statistical Model (DLASM) to better teach healthcare workers in safety practices. Those in charge of employee safety may benefit from data gathered and analyzed by AI automation. The financial burden of workplace events, injuries, healthcare, and prosecutions might be reduced by implementing an appropriate exercise program based on a meaningful learning model for employees. DLASM technique will lead to happier, safer, and healthier employees. articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review Of Load Demand Forecasting And Optimal Sizing In Stand Alone Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The rising global energy consumption necessitates a shift towards sustainable energy sources. While optimal sizing makes sure that the renewable energy system (RES) has enough capacity to satisfy the demand, accurate forecasting aids in recognizing the energy need. Forecasting load demand and selecting the right size are crucial for advancing sustainable energy practices. These methods aid in the integration of off-grid power systems with renewable energy sources like solar PV and wind turbines. This review of the literature seeks to present an overview of stand-alone hybrid RESs' ideal size and load demand forecasting. The assessment emphasizes how crucial load forecasting and ideal sizing are when constructing dependable and affordable off-grid power systems. The numerous elements that affect load demand, including as weather conditions, seasonal variations, and changes in consumer behaviour, are initially covered in the paper. The article then looks at the various load forecasting methodologies, including AI approaches. The best size for standalone hybrid RESs is the next topic of the review. A summary of the difficulties and restrictions associated with load demand forecasting approaches are also given in the literature study. The review emphasizes the significance of precise data collection, model construction, and model validation, as well as the necessity of including uncertainty and variability in the forecasting process. The study focusses on developing more accurate and robust forecasting models for load demand and optimizing the size of hybrid RES to enhance their efficiency and effectiveness in meeting energy demand while minimizing environmental impact.

articleTitle: Seeing Through Sound: Object Detection and Distance Analyzer for the Visually Impaired Using Audio Feedback
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Blind Aid is a technology designed specifically for visually impaired individuals, aiming to assist them in navigating their environment. Through a combination of hardware and software, users are provided with real-time auditory information about their surroundings, including details about nearby obstacles. The hardware component of the system consists of a small and portable device equipped with sensors that track and assess the user's surroundings, along with a speaker for delivering audio output. The software component utilizes machine learning algorithms to interpret and process the sensor data, enabling users to receive concise and accurate audio descriptions of their environment. By enabling simpler and more confident navigation, Blind Aid significantly contributes to enhancing the independence and overall quality of life for people with visual impairments.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurial Performance Management Using Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)

articleTitle: The role of service-oriented human-computer interaction of Low-resource, high-efficiency public transit systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Human-computer interaction (HCI) is crucial to improving public transportation in low-resource settings. The degree that people give up control to computers is a topic of discussion in various settings, including implementing smart transportation systems in rural areas. Disaster occurs because people don't believe in the system or try to change its decisions. Therefore, this study proposes a Service-Oriented Human-Computer Interaction (SO-HCI) model for efficient rural public transit. An inter-agent strategy for monitoring the rural transportation channel and the user information service is described in the service-oriented model. Human-computer interaction (HCI) is designed to maximize a predetermined level of mechanized efficiency; this efficiency level can be achieved in various automation settings, and HCI's way of thinking can shift over time. In the SO-HCI model, the uncertainty of misleading user expectations and a routine and formally defined transportation system result from implementing the Markov framework paradigm. Based on empirical evidence, the proposed SO-HCI model for rural smart transportation systems significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art in terms of rural mobility (97.6%), accessibility (95.4%), demand response (94.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), travel behavior prediction (98.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), and operating cost (11.2%).

articleTitle: Application of Wearable Sensors in Physical education for biomedical surveillance and human-machine interface
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Continuous biological surveillance requires less mechanical aid and affordable wearable technology and sensors. Provides the network with instantaneous access to large-scale resources while reducing operational and capital expenditures. articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Deep Learning Methods for COVID-19 Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The progress of precise recognition techniques and the evaluation of genetic connections are required because of the worldwide spread of COVID-19. As conventional techniques for COVID-19 detection are time-consuming and require accurate variables in order to minimize or cut short errors that could possibly occur, the COVID-19 epidemic's necessity for early diagnosis and surveillance led to the deployment of Deep Learning (DL) technology for efficient evaluation. Deep learning is a branch of artificial intelligence (AI) and Machine learning (ML), and due to its remarkable ability to assimilate new information, DL technology has quickly risen to prominence. Many DL architectures, like RNN, CNN, and long-term memory, can be utilized for forecasting, perdition, and classification of COVID-19. The intention of this paper is to conduct a comprehensive analysis of various deep learning methods, for detecting and classifying the COVID-19 virus using diverse data sources, such as chest X-rays, CT scans, and genomic sequences, to highlight their exceptional accuracy in identification. We also explore DL's involvement in analyzing the virus's genetic code, providing insight into how it evolved. It aims to deliver a summary of earlier research and its COVID-19 applications.

articleTitle: Integrated CNN-SVM Approach for Accurate Radish Leaf Disease Classification: A Comparative Study and Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Radish leaf diseases can have a significant negative influence on agricultural productivity, thus accurate and prompt disease detection is essential for efficient disease management. In this paper, this is an CNN model that can be used to forecast five different radishes leaf illnesses: alternatives Blight, White Rust, the Root Rust of Radish, Radishes Mosaic Virus, plus Radish Phyllody. This model has four convolutional layers, four maximum pooling layers, and one fully connected layer. On a dataset of photos of diseased radish leaf, the model's performance has been evaluated using recall, precision, and F1-score metrics. With precision in the range of 76.19% until 81.82% and remembering extending from 75.00% until 82.05% across individual illness classes, the results showed promising categorization capabilities. The model's overall effectiveness has been shown by its weighted average. The F1 score of 81.45%. The CNN model demonstrates its value as a diagnostic and therapeutic tool for radishes leaf illness with a 92% accuracy rate. These results demonstrate the potential of our methodology to support farmers and specialists in early disease intervention, ultimately improving the health and productivity of radish crops. Its performance and application in the field in agriculture is expected to improve as researchers continue to develop and expand the model.

articleTitle: Application of Mobile Health Technology for Predicting attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) for adolescent
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Many adults and children are affected by the distressing condition known as attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). The widespread availability of mobile phones in today's society facilitates the development of novel approaches to various problems. In recent years, mHealth has emerged due to the widespread use of mobile devices in the medical field. There are four different types of people affected by the illness represented in the application: children, parents, doctors, and educators. Parents can recognize the signs of this disease in their children, and playing games of numerous types may help improve adolescents' brainpower. Using an example, this study highlights the importance of the initiative's security features for mobile health. To protect the privacy of its users and the integrity of their data during transmission, the developed tool makes extensive use of encryption. Support and accurate treatment for Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) need to extend beyond the titration period and provide more to patients and their families than simple monitoring via consequence trials, and this is where mHealth comes in.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Assisted Physical Education and Resource Allocation Management in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: One of the most important disciplines for advancing human health is physical education (PE). There are a lot of obstacles in the way of enhancing societal, physical performance. Students able to manage their time well may expedite their healthy physical activity. Additionally, the correlation between sports and exercise is investigated. Significant challenges must be overcome to create a physical, educational environment that emphasizes ecology's defining features and provides personalized assistance. This paper suggested the detection system of higher physical education resources based on deep learning and collaboration filtering algorithms (DSHPE-DLCFA) to meet the needs of both the learner and their education facility. Specific research and student responses confirm its reliability as a resource for designing physical education frameworks. The data recommendation model comprises a collaborative filtering algorithm and a resource feedback matrix. Highly accurate and efficient curriculum material recommendations were made using a deep learning algorithm to integrate new techniques in physical education networks. The experiment's results show efficiency in providing physical education facilities compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Deepfake Image Detection with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The availability of image editing software such as Adobe Photoshop or GIMP has made picture alteration so widespread these days. Finding these phony photos is a must for exposing image-based cyber crimes. Due to its ubiquity, images produced with a digital camera or smartphone are typically saved in the JPEG format. The 8×8 pixel-sized, independently compressed mage grids used by the JPEG technique are used. Images that haven't been altered have a comparable inaccuracy level. Due to a similar number of faults throughout the whole image, each block should degrade at roughly the same rate during resaving operations. Error Level Analysis was used to determine that the compression ratio of the false image was different from the actual images.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Assisted Fine-Grained Action Recognition From Physical Education Teaching Videos
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: New machine vision and computational intelligence technology in physical education (PE) are analyzed as part of an economic analysis of sports training videos. This study suggests fine-grained action recognition (FG-AR) method for examining soccer training videos. The approaches were utilized in-house for training purposes to ascertain whether a player had successfully stopped the football. The FG-AR problem is simulated using interactions between human objects (player balls). It is proposed that entity trajectories may be used as a new descriptor for detecting fine-grained sports videos. High-level semantics and human-object interactions are useful for the proposed descriptor. Second, it is recommended that the FG-AR be implemented employing a cascaded deeper communication dependent on an object-level trajectory. The computation network is constructed using a hybrid of detector and classification systems. The phenomenal effectiveness of long-term short memory (LSTM) and deep learning-based networks on sequence data processing and the high sensor effectiveness in object identification are assets to the cascaded system. The results of the experiments show that the proposed method may achieve a precision of 91%.

articleTitle: Combination of Different Mathematical Objectives to Model Public Safety and Emergency Responses
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The universe has entered a new era in which the financial crisis is perpetual, its severity is increasing, and international communication is expanding. Thus, the public security dilemma is becoming a vital and persuasive duty for all nations and all administrative agencies. At the international and regional levels, steps are taken to respond to crises, although judicial proceedings rarely provide new ideas for managing crises. The paper proposes a Multi-Objective Hybridized Mathematical model (MOHMM) for better decision-making and crisis handling. The proposed methodology suggests connecting designers' aspirations with relief groups' capabilities, the people's long-term needs, and governmental and macroeconomic crisis issues. Through various partnerships, MOHMM investigates the public's safety crisis management to bolster the growth of the appropriate management protection system. The goal of the hybridization statistical model is to incorporate not only the immediate political and economic emergency issues but also the long-term needs of individuals and the capabilities of relief groups. The mission of MOHMM is to provide valuable advice to clients in the form of cost-effective and faultless crisis management by analyzing the variables that produce public crises and highlighting challenges in administering a public crisis

articleTitle: Smart innovative congestion pricing strategy for Traffic demand management in smart cities using Structural Equation Modelling
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: In today's urban scenario, the demand for travel has drastically increased due to certain factors such as urbanization, increased desire for car ownership and improper land use transport integration which on the other hand has an impact on the physical, social, economic and environmental factors of the city along with externalities such as pollution and loss of man hours etc. The real question is regarding the elasticity of increasing the infrastructure supply to meet the increasing demand for the transportation. So, there needs to be innovative and effective measures that would optimize the demand through managing the existing infrastructure rather than increasing the supply of roads. Congestion pricing, one of the travel demand management strategies, is the charging of vehicles to enter the Congested Zones (CZ) during the certain times of the day (mainly peak hour travel times) to reduce the private vehicular flow and make people move towards the sustainable modes of transport. Congestion pricing is addressed as a reliable tool for enhancing the effectiveness of large cities and their surroundings within the case of public transportation policies. Understanding the psychological processes and perceptions of vehicle users toward pricing schemes, as well as the public's acceptance of new pricing schemes, is critical for developing a successful policy. The focus of this research is on how road pricing influences people's willingness to change their current modes of transportation and their psychological response towards the congestion pricing strategy among the private car users. The relation between the socio-demographic characters and their response towards shifting their mode from private means of transport(car) towards sustainable transport systems are evaluated through chi-square test of significance. The user responses from the stated preference survey towards the modal shift are evaluated using Reliability analysis and Structural Equation modelling in response to the psychological latent variables to know the significant factors.

articleTitle: Research on Analyzing Smart Education Model based on Machine Learning and Virtual Reality Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Most exciting and instructive for actual study and learning different methods to convey facts graphically for academic purposes are the 3D panoramic mode and interactive experiences. Users may get a better feel for the digital world's immersive visualization capabilities due to the development of 3D user interfaces. In this study, Machine Learning and Virtual Reality in Smart Education (ML-VR-SE) Framework has been suggested to improve students' interaction, satisfaction and performance in a smart education environment. In this step, the 3D objects visualization module's model has been designed to restore the 3D images. In a virtual reality environment, 3D objects are treated as templates and algorithms rather than physical objects. The intended 3D user interface, such as Graphical User Interface (GUI), is performed in a cloud-based training program that includes a virtual tour. The size of the OS modifications is shown as a function of the template and shape of the 3D structures used. The experimental findings demonstrate that the suggested machine learning and virtual reality in smart education (ML-VR-SE) framework achieves the best performance, interaction ratio and student satisfaction compared to other popular methodologies.

articleTitle: Fake News Detection Using Naïve Bayes and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Social media platforms have revolutionised how people engage with the outside world by allowing people to voice their thoughts and exchange information on a variety of topics that interest them. However, because social media is so widely used, information spreads quickly among thousands of users, giving it the perfect environment for the fast spread of false information. The alarming rise of false news presents major concerns to both users and the nation, demanding prompt action. On a national and personal level, the potential harm that misinformation can do calls for serious thought and preventive action. Online fake news identification has garnered substantial research interest, yet the results of past endeavors, particularly using the naive Bayes classifier, have yielded suboptimal performance. In response, this work aims to go deeper into the topic and address the constraints of the naive Bayes classifier by investigating techniques to improve its efficiency. To efficiently identify fake news on social media, we provide a machine learning-based technique that makes use of Naïve Bayes and Support Vector Machine classifiers. Our main goal is to provide users with a tool that enables them to separate significant information from false information and determine the reliability of news stories they come across online.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Enabled Emergency Green Corridor Mechanism for Ambulance Services in Smart City
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: With more and more people relocating to cities, the roadways become more congested every day. The demand for essential services like organ transplants is increasing as the population continues to expand. This flood of people also makes it more difficult to offer emergency care within cities or between them, which causes too many lives to be lost because they couldn't get the right care or organs quickly enough. This research paper proposes a ground-breaking solution for accelerated patient transportation. With the help of contemporary innovations like GPS, RFID labels, and readers, this concept creates an adaptive green corridor for life-saving organ transit situations.

articleTitle: Transportation Regulation in Smart Cities: A Study in Cognition Sensor Network Development
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Smart cities are designed to maximize efficiency and equity in resource utilization and distribution. One of the primary goals of a smart city is to improve communication between citizens and their government at all levels. People can live peacefully and harmoniously in a city with a well-developed public transportation system. A shortage of traffic data, inefficient use of available resources, and inadequate demographic and ethnic data are all factors that complicate the design of a system for managing transportation. Real-time data that can be relied upon is essential for any transportation system. Congestion causes delays in the flow of people, goods, and government services. Sharing information about traffic congestion is sufficient for efficient operation. Intelligent transportation systems improve the quality of life in a city by easing traffic, reducing pollution, and improving accessibility. A cognitive sensor network framework (CSNF) is offered to manage transportation in smart cities better. The CSNF plans a transportation system to aid in the smart city's design, which constantly analyzes traffic flow and attends to potential problems in advance. The results of the CSNF's experiments show that it can cut traffic volumes by 92.23 percent while simultaneously achieving an efficiency of 96.67 percent, a performance that is unreachable using conventional methods.

articleTitle: Online Student Assessment Based on Facial Expression Recognition through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Engagement is a major aspect of smart teaching since it reveals how much students are learning. Compared to traditional face-to-face classrooms, online courses lack exact, quick, and relevant communication and feedback between lecturers and students. Existing data structures for automated student interaction are geared at analyzing participation, which is crucial to the interface's ability to provide appropriate feedback. Students may struggle with data structures and algorithms due to their novelty, yet the topic is important because of the strategic model teaching framework that includes automated teaching of data structures via group-based collaborative interactions among peers. This paper suggests the Novel Facial Expression Recognition Model (NFERM) based on Machine Learning to analyze student engagement and evaluate student assessment in online education. Students are “engaged” when they maintain high attention, curiosity, enthusiasm, optimism, and passion for what they are taught or learning. Evaluating students' progress in an eLearning course is best done via activities including quizzes, matching tests, self-assessments, studies, questions for issue resolution, questions based on scenarios, and games. To better identify interactions in photos, this research offers a machine learning approach that addresses the issue of data imbalance by first training on publicly accessible facial expression data. This research presents a virtual computer's-eye-view of a proposed architecture for incorporating facial expression recognition (FER) algorithm into online learning platforms.

articleTitle: Empirical Evaluation of Internet of Things Oriented Enriched Women Protection System with Smart Sensors Association
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: As a result of modernity and advances in technology, protecting women has emerged as an issue that has to be addressed immediately not just in India but also in a number of other countries. Due to the structural difficulties that are connected with handling cases of this nature, the police are unable to respond to valid calls for assistance. It is difficult to approach the murder scene in an individual manner, and it is hard to determine where the crime began and where the victims died. It is also difficult to determine who committed the crime. As a direct consequence of this, the proportion of crimes in India that are perpetrated against women and children continues to climb, sowing the seed of dread in the minds of the people who live in the nation. As a direct consequence of this, the government has enacted a multitude of regulations with the intention of safeguarding the well-being of women and children. If a female volunteer in this research feels uncomfortable or unsafe in any way, she is told to use the “Panic Button”. All these communications are handled by using the latest technology called Internet of Things (IoT) and when the alarm is activated, the gadget makes use of technology known as the Global Positioning System (GPS) to determine the exact position of the user. It then sends a signal of distress through GSM to the user's phone as well as the closest police station. A module connected to the Internet of Things is used to perform continuous monitoring of the location, and the website is automatically updated to reflect any changes. The buzzer will go off as soon as the accelerometer detects that she has fallen, therefore alerting anybody in the vicinity to the fact that she requires assistance. The key advantage of this research is the development of a portable safety device that can be used to safeguard women no matter where they go.

articleTitle: Machine Vision Techniques for Digital Mesothelioma Diagnostic System
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The uncommon and aggressive cancer known as mesothelioma is mostly brought on by asbestos exposure. A prompt and correct mesothelioma diagnosis is essential for successful therapy and successful patient outcomes. The significant potential of machine vision algorithms to assist in the diagnosis of mesothelioma has recently been established through the analysis of digital images and pathological slides. The goal of this article is to increase the accuracy and efficacy of mesothelioma diagnosis by utilizing cutting-edge computer vision algorithms and image analysis methodologies. The capture of digital images of radiographic scans or histopathological slides is the first stage in the suggested diagnostic procedure. The photographs are then enhanced with pre-processing techniques to increase their clarity and quality. The images are then processed to extract characteristics including texture, shape, and colour using a range of techniques, including wavelet transformations, edge detection, and colour space conversions. Using machine learning techniques such as support vector machines (SVMs), artificial neural networks (ANN s), or convolutional neural networks (CNNs), categorization and diagnostic decision-making are carried out after the characteristics are obtained. Each image in the dataset used to train these algorithms corresponds to a certain diagnosis (mesothelioma or non-mesothelioma), and it consists of a collection of tagged photographs. The diagnostic system is validated and evaluated using a distinct dataset for sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and other important metrics. By combining machine vision techniques into the diagnostic procedure, the digital mesothelioma diagnostic system seeks to improve the precision, objectivity, and effectiveness of mesothelioma diagnosis. This technique has the potential to assist medical professionals in cases of mesothelioma in a way that will lead to earlier discovery, individualized treatment planning, and improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Transferability of Evasion Attacks in Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Natural language processing to computer vision is among the many applications of machine learning. Adversarial examples can cause models to misclassify inputs, despite the fact these models are resilient to attacks. One type of adversarial attack is an evasion attack, where the attacker modifies an input to cause a model to produce an incorrect output. The transferability of evasion attacks refers to the ability of an attack designed for one model to be effective against other models. This property is important because it implies that an attacker can launch a successful attack against a large number of models without having to design a separate attack for each individual model. This paper investigates whether evasion attacks are transferable to machine learning models. Analyzing various models and studying factors contributing to the transferability of attacks, we evaluate the performance of attacks against a variety of them. Our results show that transferability is a common property of evasion attacks and suggest that this property is due to the presence of similar features in the models being attacked. Our findings have implications for the security of machine learning models and suggest that transferability of attacks should be taken into account when designing and evaluating machine learning models for security-critical applications.

articleTitle: Psychological behavior Analysis in social media based on automated deep learning method
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Suicide rates are notably higher in countries with higher levels of psychological stress. Depression and suicide may be avoided if signs of psychological stress are detected early. The widespread popularity and real-time social media data sharing in the last several decades have aided early diagnosis in big populations. The Deep Learning-based Automated Psychological Behavior Analysis Model (DLAPBAM) has been suggested to derive psychological stress from Twitter and Facebook usage. Focusing on deep learning and a transfer learning strategy that enhances an existing clinical text annotation collection, this study investigates methods for identifying suicide-related psychological stress. In this public opinion survey, these sources provide a wealth of information from which to draw. This study details a method for analyzing and synthesizing the sentiment of reviews that have been detected using deep learning methods, which may be quite useful when trying to anticipate the psychological behavior of a person. The experimental findings demonstrate an accuracy and prediction ratio improvement using the proposed DLAPBAM model over prior approaches. The experimental outcome has been accomplished, and the suggested methods prediction ratio (96.3 %), classification accuracy ratio (92.7%), efficiency ratio (96.8%), social media usage (97.9%), and error ratio (40.21 %).

articleTitle: Bio-Inspired Automated Underwater Robot Based On Fish Swimming Mechanism And Navigational Command Guiding System
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) perform subsea inspections and measurements for various maritime sectors, such as offshore wind farms and other underwater infrastructure, to decrease human risk and maintenance costs. A navigational management and controlling system for an ostraciiform swimmer robot is designed and developed. The design is more water-resistant, stronger, and can withstand higher pressures than any prior bioinspired vehicle. The main drive often employed by underwater bioinspired vehicles has been replaced by a transmission mechanism that may generate the alternating motions of bio-inspired thrusters, notably a planar fin. In this study, Bio-inspired Automated Underwater Robot (BI-AUR) has been proposed for underwater inspections. Based on the robots' original dimensions and unique swimming abilities, the structural efficacy of two distinct mechanisms suited for operation is computed. Therefore, the superior solution is developed and implemented onbroad. The robot's main controller incorporates a proper navigation, guidance, and control (NGC) architecture. After receiving its features from the access point, the disclosed system allows the vehicle to do activities without human intervention. Findings from the experiments have been reported, along with suggestions for future study.

articleTitle: Land use suitability analysis using artificial intelligence and machine learning for developing urban areas
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Urban areas around the globe are now seeing a significant surge in growth, characterized by an escalating pace of expansion. This phenomenon has presented several obstacles to pursuing sustainable development within these regions. The increasing trend of urbanization has resulted in significant population growth and a notable expansion of building infrastructure. Given these transformations, using Land Use Suitability Analysis (LUSA) to inform urban planning, allocate resources, and promote sustainable development has become crucial. Nevertheless, the current LUSA approaches need help with precision, resilience, and incorporating several environmental parameters. This research study presents a Hybrid Land Use Suitability Analysis (HLUSA) technique to tackle these issues using Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). The HLUSA framework integrates a range of established methodologies, including Machine Learning, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), and Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA), to thoroughly and precisely evaluate land use appropriateness. The findings of the HLUSA study exhibit its efficacy across various indicators, including Land Use Change (%) - 12.87%, Transition Probability - 0.54, Agreement Kappa Index - 0.82, Assessment Accuracy (%) - 92.43%, Spatial Trend (%) - 18.86, Euclidean Distance (m) - 1156.60, Temperature (<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">○</sup>C) - 28.94, and Rainfall (mm) - 139.22. The results above highlight the resilience of HLUSA in tackling the intricacies associated with urban expansion, rendering it a helpful instrument for urban planners and policymakers aiming to promote sustainable development and optimize land usage among the challenges posed by fast urbanization.

articleTitle: ShNP: Shielding Nuclear Plants from Cyber Attacks Using Artificial Intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: The potentially catastrophic consequences of a security breach at a nuclear site have elevated concerns around cyberattacks targeting such installations. These attacks may aim to compromise the safety, disrupt the functioning, or acquire sensitive data by targeting various aspects of a nuclear power plant's infrastructure and activities. Cyberattacks against nuclear facilities may use several tactics, including but not limited to phishing emails, malware infiltration, code injection deployment, and exploitation of software and hardware flaws. Artificial intelligence has the capability to do behavioral analysis on both individuals and equipment that are linked to the network of a nuclear facility. AI-powered security analytics solutions have the capability to evaluate vast volumes of data provided by diverse security systems, logs, and sensors. This enables security professionals to get valuable insights that can be acted upon effectively. The system has the capability to detect atypical or questionable activities that might potentially signify a cyber assault, such as illegal login attempts or anomalous data transmission trends. In this research work, an artificial intelligence-based model is proposed to shield nuclear plants from cyber-attacks. The nuclear plant attack dataset considering zero-day attacks is investigated in this experimental study to find out the optimal algorithm for training servers in the nuclear plant architecture.

articleTitle: Design of hybrid photovoltaic wind energy systems for residential and commercial applications for environmentally sustainable production
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Energy is the potential that can be exerted via material or chemical means. Primitive energy comes from wind and sun power, fossil fuels, nuclear power, and hydropower. Primary energy comes from resources found in the environment. Photovoltaic wind energy is critical to any country's economic and social development. As the price of traditional energy sources continues to rise and its negative effects on the environment worsen, the adoption of renewable energy systems is likely to expand. Regarding production and industry, the cyclical nature of wind and photovoltaic renewable energy sources and their high investment cost are two key concerns. The Internet of Things-based Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm algorithm(IoT-PSOA) has been proposed in this research to control and monitor PV wind energy systems in the green manufacturing sector. Applications of the Internet of Things in renewable energy production revolve around sensors attached to generation, transmission, and distribution machinery, allowing for remote monitoring and management of this equipment by companies. IoT lowers running expenses and lessens our already limited reliance on fossil fuels. A power control circuit that responds to variations in load provides a steady supply. The Internet of Things has shown that evaluation procedures are more productive, with more precise reporting and higher quality assurance.

articleTitle: IoT Based Solar Powered Portable Vaccine Carrier
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Vaccinations are the most important aspect of public health because of new diseases and pandemics. Their availability needs to be ensured by all citizens. Many regions, including some rural and remote areas, are still facing the issue of vaccine unavailability. Although the vaccine breach was a significant concern, thermoelectric coolers are utilized as vaccine carriers. Charging the battery was also problematic in off-grid regions. Therefore, a low-cost IoT-based solar-powered vaccine carrier is the solution to these problems. ThingSpeak IoT will be used to implement temperature monitoring. ThingSpeak allows the aggregation, visualization, and analysis of live data streams in the cloud. Vaccines need to be stored within a permissible temperature range of 2-8°C. In this case, a thermoelectric module is used to cool the carrier, which is operated by a lithium-ion battery. Solar power, along with an AC adapter, can be used to charge the battery. An LCD display is also provided to view temperature readings. A relay is used to control the temperature received from the sensor within the permissible range. The live temperature readings can be monitored from the cloud platform using the NodeMCU ESP8266.

articleTitle: Big Data Framework for the Development of Public Management Application Talents using Innovative Elements in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Big data is being used by public sector entities to improve services to cities. Many government agencies are in unfamiliar territory as they strive to incorporate and integrate one novel kind of technology (big data) with another concept (smart city). Smart cities are a new type of city planning that uses digitalization to collect, analyze, and integrate key data from the city's operational core system to respond quickly and effectively to a wide variety of needs, including those of residents, the protection of public safety and the health of the environment, city services, and commercial and industrial activities. The fast pace of change in the digital economy necessitates improvements to the economic concepts that underpin it. Many distinct approaches exist to doing business and creating value in today's online marketplace. To explain the expansion of the digital economy, it has been suggested that big data analysis-based public management (BDA-PM) be implemented at the municipal level to define the status and significance of strategic resource management in smart cities. It developed a plan for allocating smart city resources based on information from the digital economy. The results of this study may be used as a foundation for other studies on resource allocation and smart city management in the information economy

articleTitle: Deep Learning with Wireless Sensor Network Platform for Multimedia Data Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Recent years have seen a meteoric rise in the volume of multimedia data generated by industries like e-commerce, finance, transportation, and social networks. Furthermore, the purpose of wireless multimedia sensor networks (WMSN) is to offer real-time multimedia applications using wireless sensors. Furthermore, Deep learning has an enormous impact on many applications involving multimedia data for tasks, including picture clustering, image classification, natural language processing, and speech recognition. Multimedia data accuracy, WMSN noise, and unattended situations are all problems for traditional methods. There are many moving parts in a successful organization, but network effectiveness is the backbone of an online business. To combat the problem of data noise in wireless sensor networks, the authors of this article propose using Deep Learning to aid in the development of Effective Multimedia Data Models (DLA-EMDM). In particular, no previous work has tried to model multimedia data cyclically using a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). Based on the simulation findings, it is clear that the proposed DLA-EMDM approach improves the precision, efficiency ratio, cost-effectiveness, and silence of multimedia data processing in a WSN. By enhancing the aforementioned wireless network, we may furnish enhanced technical support and platform services to businesses and set the stage for enhancing business performance.

articleTitle: Suicidal Tweet Detection Using Ensemble Learning: A Multi-Model Approach for Early Intervention
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: With the growth of social media platforms, there is a greater need to address pressing problems, such as the identification of suicide material to enable prompt and effective intervention. In this study, we give a thorough investigation of a suicidal tweet detection system that makes use of the advantages of ensemble learning methods, particularly the BaggingClassifier and GradientBoostingClassifier, together with conventional classifiers BernoulliNB and GaussianNB. Data preparation, model selection, training, assessment, ethical issues, and interpretability are all parts of what we do. The outcomes of our investigation demonstrate the potential of ensemble learning to improve classifier performance. While the GradientBoostingClassifier and BaggingClassifier consistently performed well across a range of measures, the BernoulliNB and GaussianNB models presented distinctive trade-offs between recall and accuracy. Our study highlights the vital value of user privacy, model interpretability, and ethical deployment. In the future, we see the inclusion of new features, partnerships with mental health specialists, real-world implementation to assess system effectiveness and ethical consequences, as well as continuing system adaption to changing linguistic and social media trends.

articleTitle: Air pollution detection and Monitoring with the smart sensor interface on the IoT platform
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Air pollution has devastating impacts on the well-being of people, creatures, and ecosystems and the stability of the environment. The proportion of contaminants and strange circumstances in an area may be precisely monitored by an air pollution monitoring system, which has been recommended to mitigate and control air pollution. Furthermore, numerous IoT-related technologies have been created to analyze and monitor different metrics of air quality to lessen air pollution's negative effects. This Internet of Things (IoT)-based approach aims to track pollution in various locations, focusing on urban areas, utilizing a network of interconnected sensors. It's proposed that different stations be located in other parts of cities. Stations update the IoT cloud with data regularly. A smart sensor is a device that can collect data from its surrounding environment and analyze it using onboard computing capabilities after detecting a particular input. This article suggests an Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled smart sensor Interface (IoT-SSI) system for monitoring the air quality in densely populated places like shopping complexes. The sensors like MQ-2, MQ-4, MQ-5, MQ-6, MQ-7, MQ-8, and MQ-135, Temperature, and Humidity sensors are embedded to monitor the air quality. The platform's sensor networks use advanced processing utilizing multiple-input-single-output neural networks to get gas concentration values that account for temperature and humidity. The realtime readings from the sensor fusion model give a vast amount of data collecting and digitally providing services on these capabilities. In addition, it looks at various scenarios where IoT air quality monitoring technologies were tested and successfully passed in shopping complexes.

articleTitle: Application of Internet of Things and Cognitive Design Protocol for Clothing Pattern Design
publicationTitle: 2023 Annual International Conference on Emerging Research Areas: International Conference on Intelligent Systems (AICERA/ICIS)
abstract: Designing software is used regularly in most fabric firms to create prototypes of new garments. The study suggests a deep-learning-based IoT-based computational modeling protocol for fashion pattern creation. For this new protocol, the computerized design algorithm relies on a Deep Learning-based Imaging Model (DLIM). Employing only 2D forms, the designer can create any pattern they like. To help choose the right hue for projects, DLIM provides palettes of various hues. DLIM interprets the concept's pattern, colors, and quantity for automated clothing production and generates a code that the machine can read. The designs have been uploaded at various locations on the IoT network, and this information is compiled into a database for later recognition by DLIM. The designer can go beyond their creativity with the help of DLIM and a computational development protocol. Simulations of this technology have shown that it reduces the mean square error rate of the IoT platform while still providing a straightforward interface and pleasant experience for customers. Therefore, the computational designing protocol for IoT platforms may deliver maximum performance (98.93<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) with minimal mistakes.
